snippet.title: I Quit my Job to Develop an "Anti-Souls" game – Spirit Axis Devlog
snippet.description:
Been a while, but I'm back fr and I'm here to stay. Think I'm gonna quit after spending 6 years on this? Think again buddy.
Sorry if I'm hard to hear at times, I'm not much of a speaker, but I have to do this for the LOVE OF THE GAME!!!!

Timestamps:
00:00 Intro
01:11 About me
02:34 Foundation
04:00 Octology
06:30 Anti-Souls
10:21 Reason
11:50 What's Next?
12:07 Outro

If you're also in this for the love of the game;
Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/C7rXTCJgcr
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4609330/Spirit_Axis/
Follow me on X: https://x.com/gazereaper
Follow me on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/gazereaper/
Listen to my music on Soundcloud: https://soundcloud.com/gazereaper
Or on Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/artist/2A70g9GYSpMAdjmwsswN3U?si=X4i7QSZzTn6jKDThfy6RIQ

I SWEAR I will TRY to post as much as possible, but it'll probably be less than you think, sorry.

In this video I go over my background in game dev, how I quit my job to focus on SPIRIT AXIS full-time, I go a little into the cosmology of Octology, the term I coined as "anti-souls" (clickbaity I know but I need them CLICKS bro) and some general details/plans about the game.

If you're REALLY curious, anti-souls in this case simply means;  upon death instead of losing souls (which are generally considered to be eternal) you lose bodily progress and material items (which we may consider as temporal). This effectively turns the souls-formula on its head, hence; anti-souls.
